ingredients.name: SODIUM STARCH GLYCOLATE TYPE A POTATO

name: Lamivudine and Zidovudine
indications_original: Lamivudine and zidovudine tablets a combination of 2 nucleoside analogues, are indicated in combination with other antiretrovirals for the treatment of human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) infection.
contraindications_original: • Adults and Adolescents weighing greater than or equal to 30 kg: 1 tablet orally twice daily. ( 2.1 ) • Pediatrics weighing greater than or equal to 30 kg: 1 tablet orally twice daily. ( 2.2 ) • Because lamivudine and zidovudine tablet is a fixed-dose tablet and cannot be dose adjusted, lamivudine and zidovudine tablet is not recommended in patients requiring dosage adjustment or with hepatic impairment or experiencing dose-limiting adverse reactions. ( 2.3 , 4 )
warningsAndPrecautions_original:
Lamivudine and Zidovudine Tablets, USP containing 150 mg lamivudine USP and 300 mg zidovudine USP are white to off-white, scored, capsule shaped, biconvex, film coated tablets, debossed with 'I' on one side and '115' on other side. They are available as follows: 
    Bottle of 60 Tablets                         (NDC 31722-739-60) 
    Bottle of 500 Tablets                       (NDC 31722-739-05) 
    Unit Dose Pack of 100 (10 x 10)     (NDC 31722-739-31) 
  
                     Store at 20 to 25°C (68 to 77°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature]
adverseReactions_original: Lamivudine and zidovudine tablets are contraindicated in patients with a previous hypersensitivity reaction to lamivudine or zidovudine.
